population: Preserve the fixed three deployed skills and pre-existing donor, original-state and later evaluation panels. At design time four previously exposed later windows (36 questions) had an unrestricted window oracle of 0.582920 and a fixed-temporal-budget oracle of 0.565884 against the native +0.02 slice cutoff 0.568407. Both ceilings are retrospective and do not predict future F1. Record all available source results at registry and freeze.
factorization: D is the relation minus activity return predicted by the measured three-label component model. B is the mean of the two non-temporal action returns minus temporal. Fit B on original measured returns only, with the parent affine features (affinity/2, held-donor standardized crowding clipped to ±3), equal history/window weights and ridge [.02,.25,.25]. The deployed 3-way utility is [0,B-D/2,B+D/2], softmax temperature .05 mixed with .20 native probability. Unlike a fixed temporal mass, every score can influence the third action. The primary is the physically verified D version, not a strategy picked on the 36 observed questions.
credit: Only original matched donor questions and rule-2 edges qualify. Each nonzero activity-minus-temporal or relation-minus-temporal edge retains its observed orientation. Divide a question's temporal-edge mass equally between its verified temporal edges, then sum by window divided by all questions. Apply squared-hinge constraints to B-D/2 or B+D/2 respectively. D within each gate-training donor is predicted by a separate source fit excluding both the outer evaluation dialogue and that donor dialogue; use all other source dialogues to predict D at evaluation. Do not infer a temporal label from a relation/activity-only edge. Disclose overlap with the previously measured direct edges.
tests: Freeze native, identically parameterized zero-credit, route-only credit, gate-only credit, both credits, rotated window credit within donor history, uniform, prior fixed-temporal credit and raw, and previous joint graph/two-edge comparators where available. Record probabilities, common draw, ordered deployed skills and measured writer and reader token counts. Rotate only training labels, leaving physical raw returns and evaluation fixed. Split F1 gains into the change due to temporal mass and change inside the non-temporal pair by averaging the two orders of adjustment. Publish oracle ceilings for fixed prior temporal mass, fixed joint-raw gate, three unconstrained decisions, and the native-mixture constraint. Evaluate all available matched windows and monitor the original full 161/123-question denominators with disjoint history fits; the independent formal test remains behind the existing gates.
